common.genericError: That didn't work. Check the connection to the server and try again.
common.connectionErrorBody: Synclet couldn't check your session because the server isn't responding. Make sure the server is running, then try again.

auth.setupHint: Create the administrator account. The username is also the folder name in the data directory.
auth.usernameInvalid: This name isn't allowed as a folder name. It can't start with a dot or contain characters like / \ : * ?.
auth.usernameTaken: That username or email is already in use.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
auth.setupDone: Synclet is already set up. Sign in with your account.
auth.selfHosted: Self-hosted. Your files stay on your server.

shell.notFoundBody: There's nothing at this address. The link may be cut off or the folder may have moved.

empty.title: This folder is empty
empty.body: Drag files here or upload them. Everything you add is stored as a regular file on your server.

notFound.title: This folder doesn't exist
notFound.body: It may have been moved or deleted.

drop.title: Drop to upload
drop.foldersUnsupported: Folders can't be uploaded by drag and drop yet. Drag the files inside them here instead.

moveDialog.title: Move “{{name}}”
moveDialog.description: Choose the folder to move it to.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.fileBody: The file moves to the trash and disappears from all connected devices.
deleteDialog.folderBody: The folder and everything in it move to the trash and disappear from all connected devices.

nameErrors.forbidden_char: Names can't contain any of these characters: < > : " / \ | ? *
nameErrors.trailing: Names can't end with a dot or a space.
nameErrors.reserved: This name is reserved on Windows.
nameErrors.ignored: This name is reserved for system files and wouldn't sync.

errors.name_conflict: Something with this name already exists here.
errors.invalid_move: A folder can't be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
errors.not_found: This item doesn't exist anymore. The view has been refreshed.
errors.conflict: The item changed in the meantime. Try again.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than the server allows.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.server_error: The server sent an unexpected response.
errors.upload_expired: The interrupted upload has expired. Upload the file again.

preview.truncated: Only the beginning of this file is shown. Download it to see everything.

none.title: No preview available
none.body: Download the file to open it in an app that can read it.
none.failed: The preview couldn't be loaded. Download the file to open it in an app.

trash.retention_one: Items are deleted for good {{count}} day after they were moved here.
trash.retention_other: Items are deleted for good {{count}} days after they were moved here.

emptyState.title: The trash is empty
emptyState.body: Deleted files and folders land here. You can restore them until they're deleted for good.

empty.title: Empty the trash?
empty.body_one: {{count}} item is deleted for good. This can't be undone.
empty.body_other: All {{count}} items are deleted for good. This can't be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}” forever?
deleteDialog.fileBody: The file is removed from the server. This can't be undone.
deleteDialog.folderBody: The folder and everything in it are removed from the server. This can't be undone.

toast.renamedHint: The original name was taken in {{location}}.

errors.conflict: This item is still being moved to the trash. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: This item isn't in the trash anymore.

trashed.hint: Inactive while the item is in the trash; restoring it re-activates the link

dialog.title: Share “{{name}}”
dialog.editDescription: Changes apply to the existing link for “{{name}}”. The address stays the same.
dialog.fileDescription: Anyone with the link can open this file. No account needed.
dialog.folderDescription: Anyone with the link can browse this folder and everything in it. No account needed.

form.passwordHint: Recipients have to enter it before they see anything.
form.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password
form.expiryHint: After that the link stops working.
form.expiryCurrent: {{text}}. Pick a new date to change it.
form.allowDownloadHint: Without it, recipients can only view the file in the browser.
form.allowDownloadFolderHint: Without it, recipients can only view files in the browser.
form.allowUploadHint: Recipients can add files to this folder. Existing files are never replaced.

errors.password_required: Enter a password or turn the password off.
errors.password_too_short: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
errors.expiry_past: The date is in the past. Pick a date from today on.

created.title: Link created
created.body: Copy it and send it to the people you want to share with.
created.rotatedBody: The previous link no longer works. Send this one instead.

rotate.title: Create a new link?
rotate.body: The current link to “{{name}}” stops working immediately. Anyone who should keep access needs the new link.

revoke.title: Revoke this link?
revoke.body: The link to “{{name}}” stops working immediately. This can't be undone.

toast.rotated: New link created. The old one no longer works.

errors.invalid: The server didn't accept these settings. Check the expiry date and try again.
errors.not_found: This link or item doesn't exist anymore.
errors.copy: The link couldn't be copied. Select it and copy it manually.
errors.noUrl: This link can't be shown anymore. Create a new link to get a copyable address.
errors.copyManual: The link couldn't be copied automatically. It's selected: press Ctrl+C (⌘C on a Mac).

page.title: Shared links
page.emptyBody: Share a file or folder from My files to get a link that anyone can open, with an optional password and expiry date.

manualCopy.title: Copy the link
manualCopy.body: Your browser doesn't allow copying here. The link is selected: press Ctrl+C (⌘C on a Mac).

publicShare.emptyUpload: Add files with the upload area below.
publicShare.folderGone: That folder isn't in this share anymore.
publicShare.footer: Shared with Synclet. The files are stored on the owner's own server, and this page is hidden from search engines.

gate.title: This link is password protected
gate.body: Enter the password you received together with the link.
gate.relock: Your access has run out. Enter the password again to continue.

gone.notFoundBody: The owner may have removed it, or the address is incomplete. Ask the person who sent it for a new link.
gone.expiredBody: The owner set this link to stop working after a certain date. Ask them for a new link.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.rateLimitedWait_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimitedWait_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.

preview.none: There's no preview for this file. Download it to open it on your device.
preview.noneNoDownload: There's no preview for this file, and the owner has turned off downloads for this link.

upload.title: Add files to “{{folder}}”
upload.hint: Drop files anywhere on this page, or choose them from your device. Files with a name that's already taken are saved under a new name.
upload.renamed: Uploaded as “{{name}}”, the original name was taken

errors.too_large: The file is too large, or this link's upload limit for today is used up.
errors.rate_limited: Too many uploads from your connection. Try again later.
errors.not_allowed: This link no longer accepts uploads.
errors.invalid_name: This file name isn't allowed. Rename the file and try again.
errors.network: The connection was lost during the upload.
errors.unknown: The upload didn't work. Try again.

publicShare.zipHint: If the download doesn't start, try again later.

downloadErrors.forbidden: The owner has turned off downloads for this link.
downloadErrors.rateLimited: Too many downloads right now. Try again in a moment.
downloadErrors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
downloadErrors.unknown: The download didn't work. Try again.

search.title: Search
search.emptyBody: Type a file name or a word that appears in a document.
search.noResultsBody: Check the spelling or try another word. The contents of new files become searchable shortly after upload.
search.noResultsInFolder: No matches in “{{name}}” and its subfolders.

recent.title: Recently modified
recent.loadError: Recently modified files couldn’t be loaded
recent.emptyBody: Files you upload or change show up here – across all folders, newest first.

new.label: Name
new.descriptionOpens: The file is created in “{{folder}}” and opens in a new tab.

disabled.title: Office isn't set up
disabled.body: Editing in the browser isn't set up on this server. Whoever manages Synclet can connect a Euro-Office server.

unsupported.title: This file type can't be opened in Office
unsupported.body: Office opens text documents, spreadsheets and presentations. Download the file to open it in a suitable app.

notFound.title: This file no longer exists
notFound.body: It may have been deleted or moved, or it's a folder.

editorUnreachable.title: The Office server isn't responding
editorUnreachable.body: Synclet is reachable, but the editor isn't. Check the connection and try again.

serverUnreachable.title: Can't reach Synclet
serverUnreachable.body: The file couldn't be opened because the server isn't responding. Try again in a moment.
